title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30111: add purchase prepayment update events
summary: Three integration events are added to the purchase prepayment line update procedure, allowing extensions to adjust line selection, handle missing-lines errors, and modify custom fields before each line update.
key_points: Event fired after filters are set on prepayment lines
Event fired before the standard no-lines-found error is raised
Event fired before each line modification occurs
Extensions can override standard behavior when subscribing
Changes applied across all regional layers (W1, NA, APAC, ES, IT, NL)
